conf.description: FireEye AX ax-alert JSON extended fenotify feed: JSON extract, flatten nested alert object into ECS per recommendations.direct.cribl, tolerate absent malware signature name/id on dynamic-analysis-only verdicts, MITRE sub-technique split, keep the os-changes detonation trace (direct route, no guard) and _raw (forensic class, unproven parser).

conf.comment: fireeye / ax-alert / json (fenotify extended verbosity via CM rsyslog, product token Malware Analysis). Hand-built pipeline: no vendor Cribl pack, Elastic FireEye integration does not cover AX. Per recommendations.direct.cribl: flatten the nested alert object, honor the explicit UTC offset on alert.occurred/alert.attack-time, and - since there is no guard hop on this path - keep alert.explanation.os-changes (this appliance's principal output) rather than stripping it as the guarded route would. AX's malware-detected.malware is treated as a single object (the work order gives no object-or-array note for AX the way it does for NX's malware-detected/cnc-services), so no array normalization is applied here. Keeps _raw: small, analyst-driven feed, forensic value high.
